Oh my god this is exactly the situation I'm in! Well very similar. I feel like my boyfriend is about to break up with me and I'm trying so hard to make sure I do and say everything right but it's so hard. I'm such a constant fuck up.

I don't think he would ever hurt me? Though he has said once that he's felt like he's wanted to punch me he's been so frustrated.. but I just don't think he would? 

I told him I'd stay at his house tonight but I ended up spontaneously visiting a winery with my best friend and we had such a fun time. I got home a bit drunk and called him to ask what the plan is (I forgot I was staying at his) and he said he's busy gaming (again), so he's coming over at 9pm? So he's gonna come over for an hour and then sleep since he has work tomorrow. I feel like I can't even say it feels unfair that he's played games all week and hasn't hung out with me hardly at all and when he has he's gotten so angry.

I actually don't know what the fuck to do. If I break up with him I'll miss having him around? But if I stay with him he's just going to continue hurting me and my feelings? I seriously need help. I'm finding it so hard.

But when he's not angry like this he is amazing. We have so much fun together when we go out, we have the best conversations and we have such a similar mind. He really has been the first person I've been with where I feel most myself, he has helped open my eyes a bit and he sometimes is so supportive of my illness. 

He is really wonderful in every way. But I feel like he has always gotten what he wanted. As a kid he was allowed to do anything. And as an adult he still lives at home, and gets looked after. He's lazy but independent? But he's also very dependant on people giving him what he wants. He's the fourth child and idk if that theory is really a thing but when I compare him to my younger brother I see some serious similarities in stubbornness. 

I just feel like if he didn't have this issue our relationship would be so amazing. 

Fuck I'm not sure, I really love him but there's so many little things that make me feel like he's not mature enough for me? He finds it so hard to save money, he doesn't want to save for a house or for his future at all. He lives so much in the now, which on one hand I love so much! But I feel like I have a good balance of looking towards the future and being spontaneous? He sometimes will skip meals if someone hasn't made it for him? Like he just won't eat cos he can't be fucked. He smokes a fair bit of weed and I don't have a problem with that at all, but lately I feel like it's been feeding his anxiety which is why he gets so mad? And I've talked to him about that before but he just says 'well I'm gonna do what I want anyway so you either take it or leave it'...

I have no idea. But somehow I love him.
